thread:
Jordan (AE): Heads up — NovaBank POC hit a hard requirement: CMKs must live in customer HSMs in two regions with split custody and an offline key-ceremony option. They also want FIPS 140-3 attestation and an estimate for 500 tps peak KMS ops. Can we scope ASAP?
Imani (Presales): Two-region split custody + offline ceremony is doable, but it changes onboarding and costs. Is their infra CloudHSM or on-prem HSM?
Jordan (AE): They said hybrid — CloudHSM in us-east-1 and an on-prem HSM in eu-west-1 colocation.
Hiro (Crypto Ops): Ok. We can support hybrid: our connector supports multiple HSM endpoints and a split-wrapping flow. Proposed architecture: Redwood holds no master plaintext. Key material is generated in each HSM; we use a k-of-n wrapping scheme (customer KMS ops validated with mTLS).
Hiro (Crypto Ops): Quick flow summary:
```
1) Offline ceremony -> primary HSM (us-east) generates CMK shard A
2) On-prem HSM (eu-west) generates CMK shard B
3) Shards combined by customer; Redwood receives only wrapped DEKs for runtime ops
4) For crypto ops, Redwood requests unwrapping via customer's HSM-proxy; HSM auth is mutual TLS + signed audit tokens
```
Ana (Security): FIPS 140-3 attestation: we can request and bundle their HSM certs and vendor attestation. We'll provide an answer pack: attestation pdfs, HSM firmware versions, SBOM references for our connector, and an operations runbook excerpt describing no-export guarantees.
Imani (Presales): Throughput: 500 tps KMS ops is significant. Are they expecting every model token to require a KMS call? If so, latency will spike. We should propose DEK caching with TTL and a burst reservation plan.
Hiro (Crypto Ops): Correct. Recommend: cache DEKs per session with a 10s-60s TTL to avoid synchronous HSM calls per token. For 500 tps sustained, propose reserved HSM throughput or dedicated circuit: either 2 vCPU connector nodes + reserved HSM capacity.
Imani (Presales): Can we give a pricing sketch to share with procurement? Something with onboarding, HA, per-op, and reserved throughput?
Hiro (Crypto Ops): Ballpark figures (for initial negotiation only):
- Offline ceremony support & engineering runbook: one-time $12,000 (includes travel or remote facilitation)
- Hybrid connector + HA (monthly): $3,500
- Reserved HSM ops tier (to cover 500 tps peak): $9,000/month (reduces per-op marginal cost)
- Marginal per-HSM-op (metered): $0.015/op; with reserved tier effective rate ~ $0.004/op
Imani (Presales): Also highlight risk premium: on-prem link monitoring and on-call augmentation add $1,200/mo.
Ana (Security): For questionnaire responses: add this snippet for custody Q: "Keys are generated and retained in customer-controlled HSMs. Redwood never exports master key material and performs unwrap/wrap operations by request over mutually-authenticated channels. Detailed attestation artifacts provided on onboarding."
Tom (Legal): Procurement asked about liability if mirrored HSMs disagree during a rotate. Our position: we provide coordination and testing; ultimate responsibility for key custody consistency rests with customer unless Redwood is retained for 24/7 ops under a separate SOW. I'll add a conditional liability clause.
Jordan (AE): Can someone draft a short SOW paragraph and a 3-line technical blurb I can drop into the LOI?
Hiro (Crypto Ops): SOW blurb: "Redwood will integrate with Customer-provided HSMs in two regions, support an offline key ceremony, and implement split-custody wrapping. Integration includes connector configuration, attestation verification, and verification testing. A 45-day onboarding window is included; extended ops support is quoted separately."
Imani (Presales): Tech blurb (3 lines): "Customer CMKs remain in customer HSMs (dual-region split custody). Redwood performs cryptographic operations via authenticated HSM proxies and caches derived keys to meet latency targets. Fallback and HA options available for an additional fee."
InfraBot: Created ticket SVC-8816: "nova-hsm-hybrid-poc" assigned to @Hiro; checklist added (attestation, ceremony runbook, perf tests).
Jordan (AE): Perf test plan — can we simulate 500 tps with DEK cache and 5% sustained HSM calls to validate?
Hiro (Crypto Ops): Yes. Test plan: 48h run, ramp to 500 tps, configured cache hit ratio 95%, simulate HSM failover for 30m; measure p95 latency and ops success rate. Add margin for on-prem WAN latency.
Ana (Security): Make sure we collect vendor-signed FIPS docs and firmware hashes before ceremony.
Tom (Legal): I uploaded the conditional liability clause to the deal folder; flagged the parts where procurement usually pushes back.
Jordan (AE): Thanks — I'll send this to NovaBank. I'll attach SOW + pricing sketch + perf plan. Will update thread with their response.
